dataset: FLARE analytical irradiation inventories; reference60 + IAEA U235 yields

reference_inventory.source: NUREG/CR-4467, Table A1, pp.16–17; basis p.15
reference_inventory.reference_time: accident initiation just prior to shutdown for refueling
reference_inventory.scope: 60 consequence-analysis nuclides, not complete depletion inventory
reference_inventory.decay_method: independent isotope decay; no daughter ingrowth

sources.yields: IAEA LiveChart cumulative U235 thermal yields; retrieved2026-10-23
sources.dcf: Recovered FGR11 Table2.1 maximum represented class and FGR12 TableIII.1 direct cloud effective dose
sources.photons: Existing FLARE IAEA ENSDF gamma data and energy binning, extracted2026-10-22

limitations: No full depletion, neutron capture or evolving U/Pu fission mixture
13 capture/activation/actinide inventories retain reference power and B/33 scaling
Cumulative yield approximation omits explicit precursor delays except parent-controlled Y90
Continuous full-power-equivalent irradiation; no outage history
Three equal batches are a sensitivity assumption, not verified plant history
Nine-group accident decay has no general daughter ingrowth
Photon data retain preceding shine model energy/intensity omissions
